value.rationale: A natural model-control question remains unresolved by mean first-passage comparisons: at equal average completion time, does boundary-triggered resetting concentrate or disperse hitting time? The proved all-geometry threshold CV(W)=sqrt(2/3) exactly separates the two possibilities, realized by deterministic, gamma and exponential holding distributions. It is a motivated, parameter-free structural criterion rather than an arbitrary finite example.
